title.zh: Chip Maker SK Hynix Posts Record Quarter as AI Memory Demand Overwhelms Supply
title.en: Chip Maker SK Hynix Posts Record Quarter as AI Memory Demand Overwhelms Supply

current_state.zh: SK Hynix posted record third-quarter revenue of 104.6 trillion won (up 328% YoY) and 83.3 trillion won operating profit at an 80% margin, saying AI-driven DRAM and HBM demand will exceed supply through 2030 with volumes through 2029 effectively sold out.
